destination.name: The magistrate or municipal court in which the § 17C-5-2(j) charge was pending
destination.detail: Nothing is submitted by the participant after the continuance. On successful completion of the test and lock program the court dismisses the charge and expunges the record as it relates to the alleged offence, on the statute's own terms. The guidance tells the participant how to confirm that the court in fact did so and what to do if the record still appears.

participantFilingRequirements: Division of Motor Vehicles record of Motor Vehicle Test and Lock Program completion

deliveryModelReconciliations.publicName: Asking for immediate sealing on the day your case is dismissed or you are acquitted
deliveryModelReconciliations.question: Which treatment controls il-immediate-seal: no LegalEase filing, or a generated attorney-handoff petition for counsel to file during the same disposition hearing?

conflictingStatements.statement: LegalEase does not generate a filing for this route. The product is telling the participant the right exists and to ask counsel to file it that day.

provenance.sourceStatement: Output strategy: process_guidance. LegalEase cannot be in the courtroom and cannot file during a hearing.

conflictingStatements.statement: Delivery is attorney-mediated. The packet is prepared for retained counsel, appointed counsel or the public defender to file during the disposition hearing. Do not tell the participant they may self-file it after leaving court.

provenance.sourceStatement: § 5.2(g)(5)(A) says "the defendant's attorney may immediately petition the court, on behalf of the defendant." ... The immediate route is drafted around represented defendants at a live hearing.

deliveryModelReconciliations.requiredResolution: Counsel must adopt exactly one controlling delivery treatment. Adoption must identify the reviewed packet and legal-output hashes; a future changed output requires renewed adoption.
